title: Preview animated background transfer tiles
changes: Browse descriptor-linked transfer controls, shared tile banks, raw frame durations and destinations; connect transfers with background tile views.
Display paged 4-bit transfer frames with base or alternate palettes, optional looping and playback from a chosen frame at a configurable tick rate.
validation: Synthetic unit rom-data-viewer-bgtrans-synthetic-71aiupi2 passed 34 projection, browser, scope and existing-view checks.

Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-bgtrans-recovered-7t3o9ck4 matched reconstructed JSON, 97 links, 42 controls, 34 tile banks and 76 source ranges; first and last frame pixels for every link passed in Chrome.
The same unit matched all 11 Python and Docker files; two validated ignored wiki pages were published under preimage guards.
limitations: The preview interprets transfer tiles in 4-bit form and does not assemble scenes or reproduce live flags, reverse playback or partial DMA. Native Windows, other previews and exact audio remain open.
